The academic excellence of Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) is reflected in its student’s exemplary record in placements in the corporate and engineering sectors. The Department has consistently maintained an excellent recruitment record. ECE graduates are recruited by some of the world’s leading corporates like WIRE DELTA, INFOPINE, VEE TECHNOLOGIES, and SEVENTH SENSE etc. Students are given training in soft skills, personality development and how to face interviews. Students often graduate with more than one offer and are given an additional ‘dream option’ to choose the company of their choice.
